workflow_evidence: RTEC submits the completed Title VI/LEP Plan to the Kentucky Transportation Cabinet Office of Transportation Delivery for approval.
The transmittal is signed by RTEC's Executive Director and treats the plan as an enclosure.
The January 2026 plan itself records Board approval on January 19, 2026, providing a plausible sequence of Board approval followed by state submission.

anomalies.finding: The file stored under a '2023 Cover Letter' filename actually prints January 19, 2026 and refers to the same submission subject as the 2026 cover letter.
anomalies.handling: Use printed document date and SHA-256 as source identity; do not infer the document is from 2023 from its filename.

anomalies.finding: Both cover-letter versions tell the recipient to call Sheila Stallsworth or the Executive Director, while the January 2026 Title VI plan identifies Clarissa Hodge as Title VI Coordinator.
anomalies.handling: Preserve as submitted-source evidence, but flag the contact wording for reconciliation rather than treating it as the current coordinator assignment.

anomalies.finding: The two source letters are substantively the same transmittal with different printed dates (January 19 versus January 21, 2026).
anomalies.handling: Retain both SHA-distinct artifacts and link them as near-duplicate submission variants.

inferred_submission_sequence: State approval/acceptance evidence for this exact 2026 submission has not yet been established from these two letters alone.
currentness_gap: Locate the corresponding Kentucky OTD approval/acceptance response for the January 2026 Title VI/LEP submission, if present in the archive.
